title: Fast Data-Driven Modeling of Hydraulic Clutch Control Pressure with Latch-State Classification and Gaussian Process Regression
summary: This paper presents a data-driven method for modeling the pressure response of a hydraulic clutch control circuit. The system consists of a variable-force solenoid, accumulator, pressure regulator valve, and latch valve, and exhibits nonlinear behavior caused by hysteresis, latch transitions, and actuator dynamics. A baseline model using commanded current variables captured the general pressure response but failed to represent hysteresis and latch behavior accurately.
